versions.changelog:
Initial release — provides a structured, unbiased exercise bike consultation to help users determine ideal bike specs.

- Guides users through targeted questions on fitness goals, body type, space, noise, and tech needs.
- Recommends exact specification requirements (not specific brands or models).
- Adapts language for user knowledge level, avoiding technical jargon when necessary.
- Ensures all user needs are covered before delivering specs.
- Designed for buying decisions only; does not address repairs, troubleshooting, or training programs.
